description: This Python source file defines a class `ClinicalAgent` that provides medical guideline-based suggestions for diagnostics and supportive care based on user queries. It uses a retrieval augmented generation (RAG) approach to fetch relevant guideline snippets and derive tailored recommendations, including suggested tests and medicines, along with contextual notes and a medical disclaimer.
